unsupported: analyze=average (and its numeric forms): per-slice float sums averaged over slices depend on the native thread count (measured: default threads and -filter_threads 1 differ); refused while parsing

analyze=minmax on chroma planes with more than one row: per-slice extremes averaged over FFMIN(chroma rows, threads) slices depend on the thread count (measured); refused in geometry() on every planner and repeated in frame(). One-row chroma planes (one native slice) are implemented

Every pixel format other than yuv420p, yuv422p, yuv444p and yuva420p (yuvj420p/422p/444p on linear chains): no frame storage; the shared negotiators refuse the pick by name. Native picks yuvj444p from gray and yuva444p from argb/rgba/abgr/bgra
enable= timeline (refused: 'Colorcorrect timeline expressions are not implemented')
Runtime commands rl/bl/rh/bh/saturation/analyze/enable (refused with the unsupported code)
Option expressions such as 1/3 or 0x1 (refused: 'Only constant decimal colorcorrect <option> values are implemented')
nodeVersion: v24.22.3 (/opt/node24 in the sandbox; the sandbox default was v22.23.5)

notes: Scope deviation from the spec: the spec lists analyze=minmax as implemented, but minmax_slice8 results are averaged over FFMIN(chroma rows, threads) slices, so native default threads and -filter_threads 1 differ (measured on 32x16 yuv420p). Only one-row chroma planes, where native always uses one slice, are implemented; larger ones are refused in geometry() before output.

The defaults are not an identity (c - 1 for chroma 1..47) and a fused multiply-subtract changes 15 default outputs, so every native byte comparison, defaults included, is gated to linux-x64 with it.skipIf and constant titles. The gate is a precaution from the arithmetic profile: no macOS run was available.
Native default threads and -filter_threads 1 agree on all 514 frame cases (manual, median and one-row minmax).
The sandbox reference is an unpinned build (--allow-unpinned-reference): sha256 ac302e4d... differs from the linux-x64 pin; commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm are asserted at test time.
Mutations caught: fused u (6 tests failed), rounding instead of truncation (6), ceil half_size (1), reassociated (u + y*bd) + bl (2).
Differential file runtime: about 12 s on 4 vCPUs with --maxWorkers=1.
Full npm test / npm run check not run, per the wave rules (they need edge-flac.wasm).
